free_parameters.name: context_size
free_parameters.why: Sequence length > 1 so the entry's q_len == 1 dense shortcut is skipped; the target guard reads only head_dim.

free_parameters.name: batch_size
free_parameters.why: Batch size does not enter the target guard; one batch keeps the run small.

free_parameters.name: num_heads
free_parameters.why: Head count does not enter the target guard; one head keeps the run small.

free_parameters.name: head_id
free_parameters.why: The dilated1 config branch returns before best_pattern is indexed, so any head id selects the same path.

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: Fixed seed makes the random q/k/v inputs deterministic; values do not affect the head_dim guard.

free_parameters.name: dtype
free_parameters.why: The guard reads only the integer head_dim; float32 is the repository's default attention dtype.

mocks.reason: minference_forward runs torch.arange(64, device='cuda') at import on a CPU-only torch; the stand-in only redirects a CUDA device to CPU and returns identical values.
The repository's compiled CUDA extension is not built in this environment; an empty module lets the pure-Python ops import.
Plain-Python port of csrc/vertical_slash_index.cu so the negative run can continue past the target; it is called only after the target decision.

hooks.name: flash_attn placeholder
hooks.purpose: Import-only empty module (created after real transformers is imported) because the flash-attention package is absent and the target never calls it.

hooks.name: pycuda placeholders
hooks.purpose: Import-only empty modules for pycuda, pycuda.autoprimaryctx and pycuda.compiler because pycuda is absent and the target never calls it.

hooks.name: minference package shims
hooks.purpose: Synthetic minference, minference.ops and minference.modules packages with __path__ into the repository, so the repo __init__ (GPU-only imports) is skipped while the real submodules are used.
